summary: Round-2 regression re-check of the reservations module flag gate: everything passed. With flags ON, /acme/reservations redirects to /acme/reservations/today (document 200), /acme/reservations/settings is 200, and the sidebar renders the Reservations group. With reservations.enabled=false for acme (three short off windows at 02:51:10-02:51:27, 02:52:49-02:52:57 and 02:53:49-02:53:56, each observed inside the ~40 s dev-D1 write window), document responses are 404 for /acme/reservations, /acme/reservations/settings and /acme/reservations/token?scope=setup, the sidebar shows no Reservations group, the role editor offers no Reservations permission group, and the Downtown Flagship location page shows no Reservations card. The flag was restored to true after every window and never left off; the final local D1 read (02:54:09) shows system/acme/riyadh-grill rows all true and the module is reachable again. Tested 2 assertions: VAL-FND-021 pass; VAL-CROSS-001 (step-1 module-gate behaviour only, per assignment) pass. No console/page errors at any checkpoint; no blockers.
